title: Implants modulating gene expression through bioelectricity

tellings.quote: maybe these things are are modulating some sort of gene expression to to make the beings into what they are.

plain: The small implants found inside the three-fingered bodies said to come from Nazca, Peru, might be steering the beings' genes through electrical signals, shaping them into what they are. That is a guess offered by the researcher Allan Ezarus, who studies the bodies but names no source for the idea. If it held, the implants would be working parts of the bodies' biology, not ornaments.
